messages:
alex: Noticing a weird increase in single-slot preempts in ap-south1 this morning. Eviction alerts for 0.25 GPU pods every 2-3m on certain racks.
sana: Any rx/tx errors or NIC drops? Could be inter-rack congestion causing delayed heartbeats -> premature eviction.
raphael: Node health looks fine. Network graphs show tail latency to storage peaking for hosts in rack-7 between 08:10-08:25. But eviction log lines reference 'packability' and 'affinity-loss'.
lisa: We pushed a change last night to prefer rack-local placement for batches hitting model-X to keep NVLINK benefits. That may be over-constraining small inference pods.
alex: Ah ok. So scheduler may be reserving contiguous NVLINK-aligned slots for predicted large runs and tiny pods are being bounced. Any evidence of packing heatmap skew?
raphael: Yes 5% density drop on rack-3/-4 vs +30% on rack-7. Also see a rising metric: preempt_attempts_by_request_size{gpu=0.25}.
sana: What about tenant-provided annotations? Some customers set 'prefer_locality=true' which we honor. If combined with new rack-pref heuristic, we could be double-weighting locality.
lisa: We did add tenant-locality amplification in the scoring last deploy. It multiplies localityScore by 1.5 when annotation present. Might be the multiplier too aggressive.
alex: Can we throttle the amplification for <0.5 GPU requests? That would let micro-inference fill gaps.
raphael: Quick experiment idea: add a conditional branch in scorer: if(request_gpus < 0.5) locality_weight *= 0.6. Deploy as a canary to 10%.
sana: Before touching config, can we identify top offending tenants? Dumping recent preempt traces shows three tenant IDs accounting for ~70% of placement locks. One of them is sending huge 'batch_hint' values incorrectly.
lisa: Filing a ticket to contact tenant ops. But still want immediate relief. I'm in favor of canary config tweak.
ops-bot: canary rollout triggered: scheduler-config -> sched:v2026.03.21-gpu-locality-soften (10% lanes).
alex: Monitoring eviction rate and packing imbalance. Also watch cost signals; if we end up with more fragmented nodes cost/unit goes up.
raphael: After canary: evictions down ~50% on affected racks in 4m. Packing density starting to re-balance.
sana: Good. Next steps: 1) promote to 30% 2) run tenant audit for bad annotations 3) add post-deploy fragmentation check (compute gini index over free-slot distribution).
lisa: Also schedule a rollback plan if preemptions for large NVLINK-dependent training jobs increase. Keep the multiplier toggle behind a feature flag.
alex: Agreed. I'll update the playbook and add a follow-up to add a scheduler simulation that measures fragmentation during staging deploys.
raphael: Note for follow-up: add histogram of request sizes vs locality weight to detect future mismatches.
sana: thanks team 50: keep an eye on ap-south1 for the next hour.
ops-bot: alert cleared: eviction-rate returned to baseline for ap-south1 (since 1793214379).
